caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden spoon positioned diagonally from the lower left to the upper right against a plain, off-white or light beige background. The spoon is elongated with a curved handle that is thicker at the base and gradually tapers towards the end. The bowl of the spoon is oval-shaped and shows varied coloration, with shades of brown, tan, and hints of darker brown, suggesting the texture and grain of the wood. The handle also has darker and lighter brown tones, following the natural irregularities and lines in the wood, and there are visible knots and grooves that add to the realistic representation. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Mixing Spoon
